parsed.rationale: Both participating records are located under test paths — 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift' and 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' — and both carry the name 'MockArtworkService', which is a canonical mock fixture name. Per the decision rules, any cluster where a participating record is a test fixture (is_test=true, or structurally located in a Tests/ directory) must be treated as no-action. Consolidating these two mocks into shared code would couple the AppServices test suite to the Artwork test suite, creating an undesirable cross-test dependency. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.75) reflects the natural convergence of mock objects that stub the same underlying service interface, not an actionable duplication.
